summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a 6-K reporting its purchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on 28 July 2026 as part of an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares were bought at a volume-weighted average price of 112.9945 pence (range 112.15–114.15p). The shares will be cancelled. This is a routine share buyback, a capital-return event. No premium or tender offer terms apply. Watch for ongoing execution under the programme; risk-arb is not relevant.
